subject: Request: Executive clearance for >20% hosted API concession for Healthly Labs
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@healthlylabs.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing discussion and projected usage

Hi Eleanor,

Great to meet earlier — appreciate you sharing the early usage numbers. I pulled together a quick projection (attached) of what Healthly's expected token consumption could look like with the pilot and national rollout. Two quick asks:

- Can you confirm the org-level committed minimum you’d be comfortable with for the first 6 months?
- Any procurement timing constraints (PO cycle / contract sponsor) we should plan for?

If Healthly is willing to sign a 6-month commit at the volumes in the spreadsheet, I want to discuss an aggressive introductory concession to make the pilot frictionless (I’ll need internal clearance for anything >20%).

I’ve attached the projection and a proposed mutual action plan. Happy to jump on a call tomorrow.

Best,
Sergio
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187

Attachments: healthly_usage_projection.xlsx, proposed_mop_schedule.pdf

From: Eleanor Park <eleanor@healthlylabs.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing discussion and projected usage

Sergio —

Thanks for the materials. The projections look reasonable. We can commit to a 6-month pilot with a guaranteed minimum of 150M tokens/mo for months 1–3 and a 400M tokens/mo ramp for months 4–6, with an option to extend to an annual roll if the metrics look good. Procurement can sign within 3–4 weeks once we lock pricing.

A few notes from our side: we need a lower effective unit price for the pilot to justify the upfront integration effort to our product org. Would Redwood consider a one-time concession for months 1–6? If so, what approvals do you need?

– Eleanor
VP Product | Healthly Labs

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing discussion — request for >20% concession (Healthly Labs)

Ben / Marissa —

Forwarding the thread with the customer. Healthly has committed to a 6-month pilot with meaningful volume (150M → 400M tokens/mo). They’ve asked for a significant introductory concession to make the integration go ahead. I’m proposing the following concession:

- 25% off list hosted-API per-token rates for months 1–6
- 6-month minimum term as described (non-cancelable)
- Standard SOW + standard Data Processing Addendum; no custom IP terms

Rationale: strategic reference customer in the payer-tech vertical, anticipated 3x expansion if pilot succeeds, low churn signal because integration cost is high. Financial impact: estimated gross margin erosion of ~12% for the pilot period but upside in expansion and ARR.

Please see the attached pricing grid and projected margin analysis. I need explicit exec clearance for anything over 20% concession — can you review and advise if we have margin headroom / who needs to sign off? Also looping in Priyom for contract ops coordination.

Thanks,
Sergio

Attachments: redwood-pricing-grid-v3.xlsx, healthly_usage_projection.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing discussion — request for >20% concession (Healthly Labs)

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifying questions before we loop in Mina for final sign-off:

1) Confirmed minimums and contract terms? You mentioned non-cancelable 6 months — we need that in writing in the MSA.
2) Impact to existing quota / capacity — are they multi-region (US only) or will this require burst capacity across EU? The workbook shows US-only.
3) Is there any additional professional services or onboarding fee we can apply to recover some margin?

If Healthly can accept a 6-month non-cancelable commit and pay a one-time integration fee ($25k), I’m more comfortable recommending a 25% concession to Mina with the following guardrails:
- Concession limited to months 1–6 only
- No further price reductions in the initial extension without new exec approval
- Contract should include a success metric that triggers automatic pricing reversion (e.g., average monthly tokens >= 400M over months 4–6)

Priyom — please prepare a redline with the non-cancelable clause and the integration fee.

Ben
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Hosted API pricing discussion — request for >20% concession (Healthly Labs)

Ben / Sergio —

After reviewing the economics and strategic rationale, I approve a one-time 25% hosted-API rate concession for Healthly Labs for the first 6 months under the following conditions:

1) The 6-month term must be non-cancelable with a written commitment signed by Healthly’s procurement (PO or signed SOW).
2) Redwood will charge a $25,000 one-time integration fee to offset onboarding costs.
3) The concession applies only to token-generation calls on the hosted-API (no discounts to embeddings or add-on services).
4) Contract to include a success metric clause: if average tokens/month across months 4–6 >= 400M, price reverts to standard list at month 7 and account is eligible for a post-pilot expansion review by sales.
5) Legal to review and sign off on the redline; Priyom to coordinate.

Ben — please file this in the deal desk tracker (HubSpot DL-2027-089) and mark as ExecCleared. Sergio — proceed to send the customer the updated commercial terms and SOW once legal returns the final redline.

Mina Haddad
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: contract_redline_healthly_v1.docx
